description: This file defines a utility class CredentialsUtils within the AWS SDK's Credentials namespace. It contains a method to determine whether a given host address is a loopback address.

classes.name: CredentialsUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods related to AWS Credentials, specifically to check if a host address is a loopback address.

methods.name: isLoopBackAddress
methods.description: Determines whether the provided host string corresponds to a loopback address by validating the IP and checking for localhost addresses in IPv4 and IPv6.
